messages.author: 78a2fd40d4b13777
messages.subject: Rterm IO
parts:
In the Rterm IO window, I am getting echos of the first column of the output.  How can I stop that behavior?  Example output:

> summaryBy(form = dep.sum ~ age, data = dvo2, FUN = ort.fun)

    age dep.sum.M dep.sum.SD dep.sum.N
11  LT75      6.82       2.04      2517
22 75-84      7.07       2.05       921
33  GT84      7.19       2.22       275

Instead of 1, 2, 3 on the lines, it has 11, 22, 33.

messages.author: eed7c15a4e3232e7
messages.subject: RE: Rterm IO
parts:
doesn't sound like a tinnR Problem.
Apparently, ort.fun selects those lines...
Without a reproducible minimum working example I can't be sure, though.

regards,
Berry

Hi Berry.  Thanks for considering this issue.  I believe the following demonstrates the issue.

set.seed(343)
nn <- 20
x <- rep(0:1, ea = nn/2)
b <- 3
y <- b*x + rnorm(nn)
z <- data.frame(y,factor(x = x, labels = Cs(Cntl,Trt)))
summary(lm(f = y ~ x, data = z))


Respectfully,

Frank Lawrence
